The controller's own provisional extrapolation (timing-comparison c9f1727d) reports provisional_full_resource_plus_allowances_usd=3574.9474 (repeat arm) and base_smoke_provisional_full_resource_plus_allowances_usd=2963.8886 (base arm), against full_training_projection_gate_usd=1200. The approved backlog rule is explicit: 'if the measured projection for the full run is at or under $1,200, proceed ... If it's over, stop and report.' The projection is roughly 2.5-3x the gate and above the $1,275 total. SPEC-15 line 26 agrees with stop-and-report, confirms the operator current-cap-decision (8c390738) raised stage-1 to $150 (for benchmark/base-resume/repeat only) while the $1,200 gate and $1,275 total remain unchanged, and states no new arm/diagnostic/cap is granted. The projection is additionally uncertain: per-epoch durations are still declining (repeat 103.62->93.73->86.50->77.78 s after a 262.43 s epoch-0), stable_plateau_established=false, and the figure rests on a single base arm/fold with an unmatched 2.51x Sprint12 ratio whose timing boundaries/workloads are not established as identical. The mechanical native-vs-returned timer gap must not be subtracted as checkpoint-only cost nor billed wall replaced by the narrower native timer.

findings.text: Stage-1 as collected is a partial screen: only two of the eight planned arms were smoked (A1_repeat and the A1_repeat2 noise control, both prep-A1_repeat), plus three single-epoch benchmarks. The four other coverage-independent arms (multiwin, L, pnormct, pnorm_v2) were not smoked and the two coverage arms (zscore, histeq) are held, so the approved backlog's 'smoke runs for all arms' stage is not complete and the FULL projection for all 40 FULL fits is extrapolated from a single base arm and a single fold (fold 0). The cross-arm extrapolation, warm-up filtering (excluding epoch 0, and for the repeat the still-declining epochs 1-4), and the use of per-fold means without any training-variance or whole-cohort bootstrap are explicitly unvalidated and must not be treated as established steady-state or as efficacy. The five-epoch exploratory Dice/lesion-F1 values (smoke dice ~0.19-0.21, lesion_f1 ~0.03-0.05; benchmark single-epoch dice ~0.08-0.17) are smoke diagnostics only and carry no efficacy claim; no plateau may be asserted and no missing arm timing may be imputed. SPEC-15 line 28 agrees and requires same-arm selected-GPU smoke timings for every arm, stability evidence, validated integration/resume, all 40 rows, independent review and ordinary gates before FULL.

rationale:
Stage run_spec_review: independent (opposing-lane) desk review of the author's version-15 response to the genuine collected-smoke REVISE11 for BACKLOG item 4. No implementation, experiment, model call or paid execution was performed in this reviewer workspace, and I did not write or revise scientific code. I read the mandatory artifact index (8e0cadc1) and review instructions (8a31ea21), the submission bindings (.review-submission-config.json), the current finding status index (6e6f1b42: records 1-7,9,10,11 all status=open, resolution=null), and the preserved prior reviews including review11 (1d022825) and review10 (bd6252de).

Inspected current originals: run_spec SPEC-15 (23ac2939, a response/documentation proposal, not dispatch); authored-execution-plan (original 6710273c, readable JSON ec5cee3c, schema scientific-execution-plan/v2) with its seven preprocessing rows and 51 fits (3 benchmarks + 8 smokes + 40 FULL, 8 arms x 5 folds) intact; notebook_provenance (6517cc0b: original_unchanged true, real_data_execution false, scientific_approval false, notebook fca431ba, patch 80a6d254); version-15 synthetic-tests receipt (5450c201: PASS, exit 0, five tests pass, test_execution_module 23 run/0 skip, real_notebook_execution false, full_notebook_executed false, ISOLATED, network UNSHARED, no_model_call true, patient_data false, module 3925313...); execution_conditions v15 (077b82ac: execution_authorized false, scientific_acceptance false, HELD_FOR_BACKLOG_ITEM_4, F-SELF-REVIEW-NOT-OPPOSING preserved); frozen operator constraints (101f869a) and the five operator decisions; current-cap-decision (8c390738); registered development-frozen-partitions original (2c197a9a); and the stage-1 results via controller-collection-index (ec0ba0d5) with benchmark/smoke epoch-timing/metrics/validation files and timing-comparison (c9f1727d).

Positive verification. (1) Partitions: all seven preprocessing rows bind partitions_sha256 to the exact registered original 2c197a9a under declared-preprocessing-partitions/v1, with source_capture b252b308 and emitted split d339296c. (2) Scope: frozen 99 development patients only; no reference to the 49 reserved or any final-evaluation/reserve patients; target is follow-up infarct tissue; prior exposure (incl. Sprint12b) disclosed. (3) Contrary evidence preserved against Dice-only promotion: Sprint12 normalization Dice +0.003 [-0.015,+0.020]; external 13A fusion Dice +0.028 [+0.015,+0.042] with lesion F1 -0.030 [-0.048,-0.015]. (4) Plan/code unchanged and byte-identical to the reviewed base (6710273c / 80a6d254 / fca431ba); no silent narrowing — the two coverage arms remain in the plan though runtime-held. (5) Real stage-1 base execution is genuine: three real benchmarks (A100 278.17 s, H100 228.14 s, B200 166.28 s; B200 27.11% faster than H100, satisfying the 20% rule), two real five-epoch B200 smokes with a genuine native interrupt/resume (loaded_native_epoch 1; native-resume PASS) and held-out scoring over 20 fold-0 patients, all validation checks PASS; the five-epoch Dice/lesion-F1 are exploratory diagnostics only.

Why REVISE rather than APPROVE or REJECT. APPROVE requires findings=[] and applies only to this collected validation stage; it cannot authorize full training, release coverage arms or waive the $1,200 gate. Genuine open blockers and material limitations remain, so they must be surfaced and APPROVE is unavailable. U1: the smoke binds only the VERIFIED base inventory b84b5f87; the coverage inventory 28db16cd and the composed-Volume confinement proof for the full execution-root are still undelivered, as SPEC-15 line 20 concedes. U2: real integration is established only for the two base arms on fold 0; GPU/production/all-arm integration is not established, and the version-15 synthetic receipt exercises only AST-extracted pure functions (real_notebook_execution false) — synthetic tests never establish real execution or efficacy. U3: coverage arms and derived_ctp_support remain correctly and unconditionally held with no authenticated source originals; the instructions forbid closing coverage findings by promise or silently narrowing the frozen full plan. Budget: the controller's own measured extrapolation projects FULL at ~$2,964 (base) to ~$3,575 (repeat), far above both the $1,200 projection gate and the $1,275 hard total, and the backlog rule requires stop-and-report when the projection is over $1,200 — a finding touching spending caps/approved scope, routed to the operator; the operator cap-raise to $150 is stage-1-only and does not relax the gate/total. Partial-arm: only two of eight arms were smoked and per-epoch durations are still declining (stable_plateau_established=false), so the cross-arm/warm-up-filtered FULL projection is not scientifically established and no plateau may be asserted; the mechanical native-vs-returned timer gap must not be subtracted as checkpoint-only cost. F-SELF-REVIEW-NOT-OPPOSING: preserved open blocker requiring opposing-family review of the exact executable bytes before execution authority. None of U1/U3/F-SELF-REVIEW nor the partial-arm limitation is closable in this workspace; the budget finding requires operator handling. REJECT is not warranted because the stage-1 base execution is genuine and technically valid and the defects are addressable through delivery of authenticated coverage provenance, completion of the remaining arm smokes, a re-scoped or re-authorized budget, opposing-family review of the exact bytes, and a new reviewed plan version. The author's version-15 response is honest: it preserves all prior findings as open, makes no scientific code change, asserts no efficacy from the exploratory smoke scores, agrees with stop-and-report, and proposes a bounded cadence/warm-up diagnostic only as a separately-registered item requiring its own operator scope/budget — it does not add that diagnostic to the 51-fit plan and claims no closure. No verdict from this stage authorizes GPU, coverage release or full training, closes any prior obligation automatically, or admits paid execution; provider admission and the separate execution-validation and spending gates remain required transitions. This verdict is carried solely by the findings array, not by any prose marker.
